name: Ar Nosurge ~Umareizuru Hoshi e Inoru Uta~
original_name: アルノサージュ ～生まれいずる星へ祈る詩～
source:
On the planet Ra Ciela, humans and spiritual lifeforms known as Genoms once co-existed.
That was a long time ago; and the world has since lost its former beauty.
People have adapted to this poorer new enviroment and manage to eke out a living.
One day, a race known a the Sharl invaded and began kidnapping humans, who found themselves helpless against their mysterious Song Magic.
All seemed lost until, unexpectedly, the Ancient Genoms returned to give people hope that one day there will be peace.
translation:
在拉·谢拉行星上，人类曾经与名为基因体的灵性生命共存。
那已经是很久以前的事了；如今，世界失去了昔日的美丽。
人们适应了日益恶化的环境，勉强维持生计。
某天，一个名为夏尔的种族入侵并开始绑架人类，而人类在神秘的歌魔法面前毫无还手之力。
一切似乎都已无可挽回，直到古代基因体出人意料地归来，为人们带来了终有一天能够和平共处的希望。
